rootCause: The shared reservation compiler and transaction primitive were not invoked by canonical action-plan or order-intent persistence. An opening intent could therefore reach the existing coordinator without a shared-capital claim, including after restart.
implemented: Schema-071 canonical new-risk plan persistence requires a qualified account observation. Catalog failure or malformed capability results fail closed, without a caller-controlled bypass flag.

The plan supplies canonical quantity, strategy, exact contract identity and economic floor. Its persisted decision supplies the cost-model version, and persisted contracts verify strike and multiplier.

D reserves spread-width minus minimum permitted credit plus both legs' modeled cost. Q/H reserve cash-secured collateral and assignment capacity. This does not alter risk limits, quantity, strategy authorization or empirically unproven EV.
Qualified envelope, reservation, chain, plan and plan event persist in the same database transaction. A later plan failure rolls back the envelope and claim too.

The existing order-intent store binds intent and native legs to the exact reserved plan in the same transaction. Account, candidate, authority hash, quantity, contract/package, credit floor, freshness and claim state must match.

READY-to-SUBMITTING rechecks reservation binding through the same checked-out transaction client. Pre-migration or restarted unbound opening intents cannot bypass this guard. There is no provider call or nested pool acquisition inside this transaction.
Ambiguous-commit verification requires both persisted plan/intent and the matching reservation. A local status or elapsed timeout never releases uncertain capital.

Capital admission failures preserve a sanitized typed primary code through the existing runtime sanitizer and retain full reasons for the admission consumer. Private group labels and malformed field paths are not exposed as public error messages.
Broker reads, reconciliation, cancellations and risk-reducing close paths do not require a new opening reservation. PaperOrderCoordinator remains the sole broker mutation authority.
Schema 070 keeps its existing path. Schema 071 remains outside the runtime compatibility ceiling and must not be deployed with these remaining integration gaps.

remainingMandatoryIntegration: The actual Production cycle caller still does not supply PlanCapitalObservation. It must assemble one reconciled physical-account observation, exact options buying power, contract and group metadata, policy and timestamps before opening the transaction.
Native held positions, stock inventory and assignment evidence need qualified envelope support. The present compiler deliberately refuses unsupported exposure rather than treating it as zero.
Filled-position lot reflection and exact broker buying-power attribution remain unproved. Reservations remain conservative and must not be claimed as complete nonduplicated allocation.
Candidate-bound AEGIS needs concurrent commitment reassessment. Hard-cap admission alone is not an aggregate AEGIS replacement.

Native partial-leg, assignment/exercise, stock, close, replacement and unsubmitted-plan expiry/release require canonical reconciliation wiring. Roll-open is blocked on schema 071 until its reservation producer is integrated.

One economically ordered account-wide frontier must feed proposal admission. The primitive supports ordered batches, but per-symbol publication alone does not prove economically ranked cross-strategy allocation.
Rejected-envelope retention, natural runtime evidence, exact continuation-SHA CI and governed release review remain required. No strategy budget or opportunity-reserve threshold was invented.

releasePreparation.activation: Require native lifecycle, reflection and aggregate-risk proofs before new schema-071 entry activation. Do not weaken current controls or grant research strategies authority.
